scope: Complete native/Fuse window checks and archive evidence for player revisions.

startup_and_playback_timing.includes: all elapsed CPU/ROM/disk/IRQ/ULA time from PLAYER entry to finished; excludes BASIC loading PLAYER and human disk changes

timing.disk_latency_note: Fuse call intervals combine ROM execution, physical emulation, IRQs and contention; no artificial separation

mask_comparison.scope: Prove identical video/AY streams and per-frame mask-path CPU deltas.
mask_comparison.next_packet_note: Unchanged stream; startup sector growth shifts track/side crossings and service calls. Do not assert equal packet cost.

cycles.scope: CB44 mode reader against CB41, both with fast_masks=False; IRQ, ULA, packet copy, audio and disk excluded
